name: np-campaign-live
_comment: ARM 4 — the live-parse arm. Row NP's whole Hand (§4) is a REWRITE that runs upstream of both parsers, so the mock keyword parser cannot judge it: the audit's A4/A5 findings were live-only by construction. This arm speaks to the Emperor the way a player would — named, by title, in the first person, with the trailing self-marker — in sentences the golden corpus does not contain, and mixes in the diplomatic forms the A4 verb gate must NOT capture. Also exercises marshal voice and Talleyrand. `turns` keys are the driver's 1-based LOOP INDEX (PC15-H).

1: I will take the field myself and march to Lorraine
Ney, hold your position at Rhineland
2: the Emperor will march to Rhineland
3: I will offer an alliance to Prussia myself
6: the Emperor is displeased with Bernadotte
7: I will lead the assault on Mack in person
8: Murat, ride down the Austrians at Swabia
9: the Emperor of Austria demands Venetia
13: I will march on Vienna myself
